name: China Electronics Technology Group Corporation, 7th Research Institute (CETC-7)
zh: 中国电子科技集团公司第七研究所

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation, 7th Research Institute (CETC-7)”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists. The US Commerce Department listed it in August 2020, finding that it had been involved in China’s land reclamation in the South China Sea.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.

sources.title: Addition of Entities to the Entity List, and Revision of Entries on the Entity List (85 FR 52898, 27 August 2020)
